strings.en: You're way too soft!
I won't let you!!
I'm going all out!!
Brace yourself!
Out of my way!!
Come on, come on, quit spacing out!!
Don't underestimate me!
I'll settle this in no time!
Get in my way and I won't hold back!
Now you'll learn the Valsione's power/　the hard way!
When it comes to power, I won't lose!
I'll show you what I've got!
I'm taking the first move!
Gotta make up for my late start!
This'll cut you in two!
I know my way around a sword!
Take this!!
Eat this!!
Go down!
Got you!
Take this!
That persistence of yours/　will only bring trouble!
Heh... Looks like you might actually/　put up a fight. Interesting.
I see, that one's no mere small fry./　Let's tighten up!
Seems you've got your reasons,/　but I can't lose either!
Against a Raftclans, I've gotta go all out!
Fu-Ruu! Let's fight head-on!
Let's settle this, Karo-Ran!
So you're the big boss! Get ready!
I'm not one to be spooked by looks!
Gu-Landon! The throne doesn't suit you!
Brace yourself, Gu-Landon!
Here I come, Iradoya!
The Baran-Schneil.../　That's a bit of a pain!
If that's the mastermind, this is easy!
Vort! I'm coming through!
Reggiane!/　Stop me if you can!
That's just in bad taste!
Get it through your head! The Cross Gate/　isn't something you can handle!
Size alone doesn't decide a fight!
Here I come, big guy!
Bigger isn't always better!
Your face really ticks me off!
Debudedabide! Don't you move!
You'll share Dark Brain's fate!
That smirk of yours.../　I'm gonna slap it right off!
I'm sick of that smirk!
Ready, Crystal Dragoon?!
I'll rip those wings right off!
Skull Knight! I'll stop your schemes!
That thing's a Kadum Hakam too.../　Bring it on!
XN-L... No, Kadum Hakam!/　I'll beat you as many times as it takes!
This time it's really the very last.../　Let's go, Valsione!!
I'm used to fighting that machine!
No matter how many times you come, it's useless!
We're not interested in your business!
Golaikunru! Get out of the Earth Sphere!
I'll put you out of business!
Why don't you just give up on Earth already?!
Keep your hands off our planet!
A Raig-Geios...!/　Guess I'll have to go at it straight!
A barrage like that won't stop the Valsione!
Get ready, Fury!
Here I come, Thick Cylinder!
Leave the Big Shoulder to me!
That horned one's mine!
Scattering the Cupids!
Stopping the Gasbra!
I'll scatter these Lamaris!
At least it's a better opponent/　than the Maguuki...!
What a gloomy opponent, seriously!
I'll exterminate it!
Disappear, Lamaris Kaana!
Getting bigger doesn't mean you'll win!
I just hope it doesn't get any bigger...!
You're gonna move out of my way!
I'm not great with that kind of thing...
A Yokijin.../　I'll take it down before it gets close!
Geez, whose sick idea was that thing?!
You hit me, I hit back!!
I won't let you do as you please!
You've done it now!!
I'll pay you back double!
You're not getting away clean!!
This is for earlier!!
Can't let you just walk away!
You came at me--now you'll pay for it!
Bad at disengaging, huh?
You poked the hornet's nest, so you lose!
Your range/　is my range too!
Ngh, they got me...!!
Ngh! I-I can't hold out?!
Agh! The damage is too heavy?!
...!! I can't go down yet!
No way?! Valsione's being pushed back?!
A-at this rate,/　even Valsione might not hold out...
No!!/　Don't go down yet, Valsione!!
Ngh! You got me!!
Yikes... I'm in big trouble!
M-maybe I took... a bit too much...
Waaah?! Th-this is bad...
Gah!! Th-this might be pretty bad...
Ngh! Am I on the edge here...?!
I'm mad at myself for getting cornered...!
Y-You got me good, Jua-Mu...!
Ngh! So this is a knight's skill...?!
Ugh!! This one's seen a lot of battle...
Your finish is sloppy, Karo-Ran...!
Y-You'll never sit on the emperor's chair!
Gomoudokka! Too early to think you've won!
Is that thing a grim reaper...?!
I won't shed a single drop of blood for you...!
At this rate,/　they'll take full control of the Cross Gate...!
Guess it's strong despite how it looks...!
Crystal Dragoon... I'm not down yet!
Never thought the Skull Knight's power/　was this great...!
If we lose to XN-L,/　all our battles up to now...!
Th-That thing's got power like Adamatron's...?!
Ngh! It's not just being controlled?!
Seems they're making use of their/　combat data too...!
I knew it wouldn't be easy, but...!
Ngh! Caught right in the barrage...!
The Fury's morale is really high...!
With it darting around like this,/　I'm at a disadvantage...!
Ngh! Getting pushed around/　by a Kaana type...!
Lamaris Ida...!/　What brute strength...?!
And I've still gotta/　deal with the Ares Geist...!
Eek! You've got some nerve!
Not yet! This is nothing!
Ow!! Why, you--you'll pay for that!
Ngh... That one really hurt!!
Owww... But!!/　I'm not beaten yet!!
Ouch! Why, you!!
Not yet!/　This is nothing for Valsione!
Tch... Not yet!/　Don't you dare underestimate me!
Ow ow... Dang, maybe I got careless.
Ngh... You're pretty good!
Not yet! The fight's just begun!
Wh-whoa, you've got some good stuff there.
Like this'll take me down!
Good match... is what I'd like to say!
Not bad, Jua-Mu! But!
Nice hit...! Fu-Ruu!
Ugh!/　No wonder you lead that bunch!
Karo-Ran... You're tough...!
Gu-Landon!/　You can back up your talk...!
Iradoya threw off my pace...!
Gomoudokka,/　things won't go according to your script!
Being that calm makes you hard to fight...!
Reggiane... I hate to admit it,/　but you're good...!
Got the toy you wanted,/　and you're thrilled, huh!
Fighting something that doesn't care/　about damage is rough!
I thought I was used/　to magic and curses, but...!
Damn it! Time to wipe/　that smug look off your face!
I couldn't sense it at all...?!
Why, you! You're a quick one!
Ugh! The Skull Knight's pushing me back?!
Th-That's all you got?! XN-L!
Ngh... This might be as strong/　as Perfectio...!
Ah! I won't let you/　do as you please with this world!
I don't wanna lose to a Zovorg machine...!
Damn Fury, they're well trained...!
Gadisword's forcing its way in...!
Relying on numbers, just like the Maguuki!
Being rushed for time backfired...!
Don't get cocky, monster!
Damn Kaana type! No more!
Ow... Yeah, gotta keep/　an eye on that one!
Tch, if this thing keeps growing...!
A Y-Yokijin's got its teeth in me...!
No good, these things are just gross!
Not good enough!!
That won't work!!
Not yet! It'll take more than this!
Hah, an attack like that?!
Like that would work/　on Valsione!
Hmm? Is that all you've got?
Owowow...! I let my guard down.
Like that's gonna work!
What was that? Are you even trying?
Hmph, that's not enough/　to even scratch Valsione!
That hardly counts as a hit.
You're hanging on, Jua-Mu!
Not enough power, Fu-Ruu!
Is that all, Karo-Ran?!
Seems you haven't broken it in, Gu-Landon!
You trying to provoke me, Iradoya?!
Is that your best, Gomoudokka?
The speed's impressive, but.../　that's all the punch it has?!
If you think that'll beat me, you're wrong,/　Reggiane!
What, all bark and no bite?
Is that all your sorcery's got, Debudedabide?!
All show, Crystal Dragoon?!
XN-L!/　I'm not listening to a word you say!
Doesn't seem as tough as Gan Eden.
Were Zovorg machines always this weak?
Gotta finish this before they focus fire!
Being targeted by Ida types nonstop is bad...!
I'd rather not see Yokijin up close...!
Where are you aiming?!
Like you could keep up with Valsione!
I've seen through it!
Come back when you're ready!
Can't hit me!
Oh dear... What are you doing?
Your moves are way too predictable!
You're not bad,/　but you picked the wrong opponent!
Fu-Ruu, quit wasting your time!
Too slow, Karo-Ran!
Is that all your precious Emperor Unit's got,/　Gu-Landon?!
However strong the attack,/　it's pointless if it doesn't hit!
Gomoudokka, take this seriously!
Reggiane! I'm not here for your amusement!
Even with the Cross Gate's power!
With a big body like that,/　you can't turn on a dime!
Only your bluster's impressive, Skull Knight!
That's all your existence amounts to, XN-L!
Zovorg machines never improve!
Being bigger makes your moves easy to read!
I've got no interest in playing with monsters!
Nyah, nyah! Lousy shot!
That's my Valsione!
What are you even doing?
Hmph, if it bugs you, try hitting me!
Too baaad!
Heh heh, I've got a sharp eye/　for moving targets!
Iradoya! I'm right here!
You weren't bold enough, Vort.
Okay, you're fast!/　But I'm no slouch either!
Impressive attack, but/　it's pointless if it doesn't hit!
Is that all, Debudedabide?
How about acting a little frustrated,/　Crystal Dragoon?!
How does that thing even work?/　Not that I wanna know.
Looks like I slipped through their fire.
The Raftclans isn't so great.
Huh, all show after all.
I don't really wanna get a good look/　at stuff like that.
I told you it's no use!
Aw, man, I can't counter!?
Attacking from way over there.../　That's dirty!
Leave the rest to me!
Here's my chance!
One more hit!
Let's charge right in, Valsione!
It's off-balance! Now!
This one's on the house!
C'mon, Masaki! What are you doing!?
Masaki, I'll take it from here!
I'll help, Masaki!
You owe me a treat later, Masaki!
Can't push the Cybuster too hard right now!
Shu! Out of my way!
Geez.../　I really don't wanna help you, you know.
Lieutenant Katina, I'll cover you!
I've got your back, Lieutenant Katina!
Russel! Leave the rest to me!
Tasuku, you owe me one!
Tasuku, this is a super special favor!
Captain, I'll cover you!
Leona, you handle the other enemies!
I'll help, Ibis!
Ibis! Let's show 'em our teamwork!
Arado! Leaving me to clean up!?
I've got your back, Raul!
Kota, I'll finish this!
I'll cover you, Ing!
Touma, leave the rest to me!
I'll lend a hand, Michiru!
Josh, I'll finish this!
I'll help, Rim!
Touya, you've got good instincts.
Calvina! We'll handle the rest!
Akimi, switching out!
Backing up Akemi!
Leave that one to me!
Not so fast!
Mind if I cut in?!
I'll handle this one!
I'll take the hit for you!
I'll stop it!
Leave this to me and fall back!
Leave this to me!
The Valsione can take it!
Masaki! Where are you looking?!
Masaki! You're charging in too far!
I won't let you hurt Masaki!
That's reckless, Masaki!
Lieutenant Katina, look out!
Looking away'll get you killed, Tasuku!
Leona, get behind me!
Captain, fall back while you can!
Ibis! Don't get reckless!
Arado! What're you doing?!
Get out of here, Ing!
Touma, I've got this one!
What're you doing, Michiru?!
Josh, fall back!
Rim, leave this to me!
Touya, get out of there!
Gotta cover Akimi!
You're being targeted, Akemi!
I'm not letting this chance slip away!
I'm just getting started!
Like I'd let that slide!
If you think it's over, think again!
Take this! Psychoblaster!!
Special attack!! Psychoblasteeeer!
Let's go, Valsione!
Take this!
Cross Smasheeeeer!!
This'll finish you!
Read this trajectory if you can!!
Go! Cross Saucer!
Run wild in every direction!
Cross Saucer!!
I'll end this in one blow!
Looks like you've made me serious.
My body is already steel,/　my heart already empty...
Vanquish all demons!!
I'll show you my ultimate sword...
The moonlight shining on my face/　will be your last sight in this world.
Haaaaaaah!
Secret Sword! Full Moon Killing!!
...Justice served!
Divine Arm!!
Take this!
Slash Ripper!!
Leap Slasher!!
Come on, come on! This is gonna hurt!
Special attack! Boost Hammer!!
Take this! Shishioh Blade!!
Shishioh Blade! Here I go!!
Graviton Launcher, fire!
This'll punch right through you!
Eat my stake!!
Gotta get my money's worth!
This is no ordinary Missile,/　in more ways than one!
System link! Lock on!
Free Electron Cannon, fire!
Haah!!
Teyaah!!
Hyah!!
Take this!!
